Fluid.ModelHint: Changing model loads its preset settings. Undo restores the previous settings and force nodes.
Fluid.Renderer.FreeSurface: Water renderer: free surface, edge foam and Fresnel shading
Fluid.Renderer.ShallowWater: Water renderer: GPU height displacement, surface normals and foam
Fluid.Renderer.Combustion: Fire renderer: temperature emission and smoke opacity
Fluid.FieldLayout.Smoke: FieldOutput RG = local velocity, B = density, A = 0. DyeOutput is premultiplied color.
Fluid.FieldLayout.FreeSurface: FieldOutput RG = local velocity, B = water volume fraction, A = 0. Water and air have different pressure boundaries.
Fluid.FieldLayout.ShallowWater: FieldOutput RG = horizontal velocity, B = water depth, A = 0. The renderer displaces a horizontal surface from the rest depth.
Fluid.FieldLayout.Combustion: FieldOutput RG = local velocity, B = smoke density, A = temperature. Internal state stores fuel, temperature, smoke and reaction rate.
Fluid.MaximumWaterSpeed: Water speed limit for bounded CFL stepping
Fluid.HeatYield: Heat released per unit of fuel
Fluid.ForcesHint: Connect up to eight nodes in list order: cell position / time → noise or curl noise → density mask / math → force. Unused final math/noise/acceleration outputs are summed before pressure projection. Inputs can reference earlier nodes only.
Fluid.DrawConsumersHint: Bind an output to a Sprite, Flexible Plane or a material texture parameter in this scope. ColorOutput uses straight alpha, DyeOutput uses premultiplied alpha, and FieldOutput contains raw velocity/density/temperature. Each spawned instance receives its own texture.
Fluid.Pass.ShallowWater: Advance water depth and horizontal momentum
Fluid.Pass.RenderFields: Publish raw velocity, density / depth and temperature
Fluid.Pass.RenderColor: Publish straight-alpha color for ordinary renderers
Fluid.Title: 2D Smoke / Ink Flow
Fluid.Summary: Fixed grid-based GPU solver. Resources are declared first, then ordered compute passes with explicit reads and writes. These arrows are dependencies, not Signal wires or a live trace.
Fluid.ResourceOwnership: The effect owns all fields and output textures. Scratch storage is reused between passes; pressure for free-surface water persists for warm starting. Main engine framebuffers and extra user-defined runtime passes require additional adapter support.
Fluid.AutomaticPlaneHint: Auto hides this plane when another renderer uses the generated output. The simulation continues when the plane is off.
Fluid.Validated: 2D fluid settings, resource plan and source exports validated. This is not an engine execution result.
Fluid.Units: Closed rectangular simulation domain. Grid axes: 8–1024 cells; source X/Y: normalized 0–1. Domain size, source radius and water depth use local simulation distance; velocity and forces use time in seconds. Shallow water uses a horizontal surface. Long-frame excess is discarded after the substep budget; water also obeys a CFL bound.
Fluid.Pass.ApplyForces: Apply source, buoyancy and vorticity confinement
Gpu.ParticleStorage: ParticleBuffer · {0} × 80 bytes · instance-owned, persistent, cleared on reset
Gpu.ResourcePassAccess: Spawn / Update read and write their own particle records. Flow Map nodes sample their named resources. Billboard drawing reads particle storage and its named texture. Resource binding controls are in Bindings.
Fluid.ResourcePlanHint: Edit named buffers, Texture2D/3D, targets, versions and pass access as JSON. Apply validates dependencies and saves an undoable source plan. Engine playback supports the fixed fluid layout only; other plans are rejected. Export resources to save this contract without executing it.
Fluid.ResourcePlanPreviewLimit: Preview shows the first 32 resources and passes. The JSON and export contain the complete plan.
Fluid.ResourcePlanRuntimeUnsupported: This resource plan is a source contract. Its allocations or operations are not supported by the current engine adapters. Restore the built-in plan before effect playback.
